verdict.rationale: Vercel documents an official CLI that deploys straight from the terminal: install it, run `vercel login`, then run `vercel`. Its docs say apps can be deployed 'from a Git repository or the Vercel CLI', and the CLI can run in automated systems authenticated by access tokens, so no dashboard is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a CLI deploy, and detailed docs on CLI deploy options such as production vs. preview targets.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote:
npm i -g vercel
vercel login
vercel
Deploy and scale web applications, APIs, and AI workloads from a Git repository or the Vercel CLI.
Deploy your app on Vercel in three steps: install the CLI, add agent support if you use an AI coding agent, and deploy.
With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system
Vercel access tokens authenticate requests to the Vercel REST API and the Vercel CLI on your behalf.
